reason: Comprehensive review of Cnova N.V.'s FY2024 Annual Report (10-K equivalent 20-F filing) found no Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosure by the company. The document contains detailed business performance metrics, financial results, and market share data for French e-commerce operations, but does not provide any company-disclosed TAM figures for its marketplace, advertising services, B2B logistics, or overall e-commerce segments. The filing references external market growth rates (e.g., FEVAD French e-commerce market growth of +2% in FY24) but these are third-party statistics, not company-disclosed TAM estimates.
